title: $π$-Properties, Uniformly Convexity and Uniform Ball Coverings Properties
summary: We prove a sufficient criterion for closed subspaces of operator spaces containing the finite-rank operators to have the uniform ball-covering property. Let $F$ be a separable uniformly convex Banach space, and let $Λ_F>1$ be a constant determined by its modulus of convexity. If $F$ has the $π_λ$-property for some $1\leq λ< Λ_F$, then for every Banach space $E$ with separable dual, every closed subspace of $\mathcal{B}(E,F)$ containing $\mathcal{F}(E,F)$ has the UBCP.
